epic.title: Epic: Restyle the rest of the site to the modern design system (chrome, blog template, tools, secondary pages)
epic.body:
## Why

The 6 primary pages (Home, Reviews, Guide, Research, Compare, Never-Hungover hub) and the blog *listing* page shipped on the modern 2026 design system (`.theme-modern` — warm paper background `--color-paper` #FAF8F4, self-hosted Fraunces display + Inter body, border-first cards with a 1px warm border, orange `--color-cta` #F97316 reserved ONLY for affiliate/buy CTAs, deeper brand green #15803d as a trust accent, SOLID non-gradient headings, 8px radius, 4/8 spacing rhythm). The rest of the site was never migrated and now visibly clashes — green→blue/purple page gradients, gradient clip-text headings, `shadow-lg/xl/2xl` + `rounded-xl/2xl/3xl` cards, a rainbow of CTA colors, and a cold `bg-gray-900` footer that meets the warm-paper body on every frame.

This epic tracks the effort to bring every remaining surface onto the modern system, sequenced by pageviews/visibility (shared chrome + the ~197-post blog template first).

## Approach (shared, adopt the shipped-page mechanism)

Every child issue follows the same recipe the 6 modern pages already use, so the work is consistent and cheap rather than re-invented per page:
1. `import '../styles/theme-modern.css'` in the page/template.
2. Wrap the page body in `<div className="theme-modern">` (the wrapper carries ALL tokens + base element rules, so this alone delivers warm-paper bg, Fraunces/Inter, solid-ink headings, info-blue links, and focus rings).
3. Delete bespoke `bg-gradient-to-*` / `bg-clip-text` / `from-green*|blue*|purple*|pink*` / `rounded-2xl|3xl` / `shadow-xl|2xl`; swap `Button`/`Card`/`Badge` → scoped `.btn*` / `.card*` / `.badge*` / `.chip`.
4. Reserve orange `.btn-cta` for affiliate/buy CTAs ONLY; demote green to a brand/trust accent; blue is links/science-callouts only; gold is star ratings only.
5. Reuse `ProductCardModern` / `ComparisonTableModern` wherever products or comparison tables appear.
6. Call `preloadModernFonts()` on mount where applicable.

Exemplary page to mirror: `src/pages/Reviews.modern.jsx` (import + `.theme-modern` wrapper + `preloadModernFonts()`). Tokens/classes live in `src/styles/theme-modern.css`; do NOT add new design tokens.

## Sequencing (highest-visibility first)

- [ ] **Shared UI foundation: modern `.theme-modern` reuse map + fill form/callout primitive gap** (p1, M) — do first; unblocks the rest.
- [ ] **Restyle shared header / nav / chrome to the modern design system** (p0, M) — appears on 100% of pages.
- [ ] **Restyle the global footer to the modern design system** (p1, S) — appears on 100% of pages; quick win.
- [ ] **Restyle the blog post template (NewBlogPost.jsx, ~197 posts) to the modern design system** (p1/XL, p0-adjacent) — biggest organic surface; split into stacked PRs.
- [ ] **Restyle the DHM Dosage Calculator to the modern design system** (p1, L) — loudest legacy page.
- [ ] **Restyle the About page (/about) to the modern design system** (p2, M).
- [ ] **Restyle the 404 (NotFound) page to the modern design system** (p2, S) — quick win.

## Cross-cutting rules baked into every child

- No `bg-clip-text text-transparent` and no multi-stop gradient text on any restyled surface.
- No `bg-gradient-to-*` page/section backgrounds; page resolves to `--color-paper`.
- Border-first cards (1px `--color-border`, 8px `--radius`, `--elev-0/1`) — no `shadow-2xl`, no `rounded-3xl`.
- Orange only on affiliate/buy CTAs; no decorative orange, no green/blue/purple/pink primary buttons.
- Mobile/a11y: zero horizontal scroll at 320/375/414px, ≥44px touch targets, WCAG-AA contrast, clean h1→h2→h3 outline, `aria-hidden` on decorative icons, visible `:focus-visible` outlines.
- Preserve all behavior: PostHog `data-*` tracking, the affiliate-click contract (plain `<a>` + `data-*`, NO added onClick), `rel="nofollow sponsored"`, SEO hooks, calculator/TOC logic.

## Constraints

- **Mass-edit moratorium** (CLAUDE.md, active until 2026-07-15, issue #366): the blog template restyle touches COMPONENT files, NOT the ~197 `src/newblog/data/posts/*.json` bodies, so it does not trip the >20-post-JSON guardrail. Do not batch post-content edits into these PRs.
- No new design tokens — reuse `src/styles/theme-modern.css` as-is (the foundation issue may ADD scoped element rules + one callout component, but no new `--color-*`/`--radius*`/`--space-*` variables).
- Every restyle must leave the already-modern control pages visually unchanged (`npm run build` + z-class verify must pass).

## Definition of done

All child issues closed; a spot-check across the site (desktop + mobile at 375/768/1280) shows one continuous warm-paper modern surface from header through footer, with orange appearing only on buy CTAs and no gradient clip-text or green→blue washes anywhere.

issues.title: Shared UI foundation: modern .theme-modern reuse map + fill the form/callout primitive gap
issues.body:
## Context

The 6 primary pages were migrated to the modern design system NOT by re-theming the shared shadcn primitives, but by wrapping each page body in `<div className="theme-modern">`, importing `src/styles/theme-modern.css`, and building UI from **scoped CSS classes** (`.btn`, `.card`, `.badge`, `.chip`, `.compare`, `.stars`) plus two React components (`ProductCardModern`, `ComparisonTableModern`). The modern CSS is scoped entirely under `.theme-modern` (theme-modern.css:22) to isolate the variant from control pages.

The old surfaces (About, DosageCalculatorEnhanced, NewBlogPost) still import `Button`/`Card`/`Badge` from `@/components/ui/*`, which resolve to the OLD Tailwind theme (`bg-primary`, `bg-card rounded-xl shadow-sm`) and are then overridden inline with green/blue gradients — the visual clash.

This is the **shared foundation** the per-surface restyle issues depend on. It does NOT restyle a page; it (1) documents the reuse plan so each surface issue points at shared classes/components instead of re-deriving them, and (2) fills the ONE genuine component gap: form + callout primitives that have no modern equivalent yet.

## Reuse decision (the key finding)

| Old primitive | Modern equivalent exists? | Plan |
|---|---|---|
| `Button` (@/components/ui/button) | YES — `.btn`/`.btn-cta`/`.btn-secondary`/`.btn-ghost` | Reuse class layer; orange `.btn-cta` ONLY on affiliate CTAs |
| `Card` (@/components/ui/card) | YES — `.card` (elev-0) / `.card-raised` (elev-1 + hover lift) | Reuse class layer |
| `Badge` (@/components/ui/badge) | YES — `.badge`/`.badge-brand`/`.badge-info`/`.chip` | Reuse class layer |
| Product card / comparison table | YES — `ProductCardModern`, `ComparisonTableModern` | Reuse components (gold star #E8A317, green winner marker, affiliate `<a>`+data-* NO onClick) |
| Input / Slider / Progress (Calculator) | **NO** | Build (this issue) |
| Alert / Info-Pro-Warning callouts (blog) | **NO** | Build (this issue) |

**Verdict:** buttons, cards, badges, and product/comparison components are 100% reusable today — surface issues need zero new component code for them, just the wrapper + class swaps. The only genuine build-new work is the form/callout primitives.

## Scope

- [ ] **Document the reuse map + per-surface migration recipe** in `src/components/modern/README.md` so every surface issue links here instead of re-deriving it. Recipe: (1) wrap body in `<div className="theme-modern">`; (2) `import '../styles/theme-modern.css'`; (3) delete `bg-gradient-to-*` / `bg-clip-text` / `from-green*|blue*|purple*|pink*` / `rounded-2xl|3xl` / `shadow-xl|2xl`; (4) swap `Button`/`Card`/`Badge` → `.btn*`/`.card*`/`.badge*`/`.chip`; (5) reserve orange `.btn-cta` for affiliate/buy CTAs only; (6) reuse `ProductCardModern`/`ComparisonTableModern` for products/tables.
- [ ] **Fill the form-primitive gap** — add scoped element rules to `src/styles/theme-modern.css` so shadcn `Input`, `Slider`, `Progress`, `textarea`, `select` inherit the modern look INSIDE `.theme-modern` (cheapest option, matches the class-layer pattern; themes the Calculator's existing controls for free once wrapped):
  - `input, select, textarea` → `background: var(--color-surface); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius); font-family: var(--font-sans);` with `--color-info` focus-visible ring.
  - `input[type=range]` thumb + track → brand-green thumb, `--color-border` track.
  - `progress` → `--color-brand-soft` track, `--color-brand` fill.
- [ ] **Add `CalloutModern`** (`src/components/modern/CalloutModern.jsx`) for the blog template's Info / Pro-tip / Warning boxes: border-first card + left accent using `--color-info` / `--color-brand` / `--color-star` on a `--color-brand-soft` surface. Keep the shadcn `Alert` API shape so the blog swap is mechanical; replaces the current green/blue-gradient callout blocks.
- [ ] **Do NOT restyle the shadcn primitives globally** — keep all additions scoped under `.theme-modern` (theme-modern.css:22) so control pages and un-wrapped surfaces are unchanged.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `src/components/modern/README.md` exists with the reuse map + per-surface migration recipe; the surface issues link to it.
- [ ] Inside a `.theme-modern` wrapper, an unmodified shadcn `<Input>`, `<Slider>`, `<Progress>`, `<textarea>`, `<select>` render with surface bg, 1px warm border, 8px radius, Inter font, and `--color-info` focus ring (verified on a scratch page or the Calculator once wrapped).
- [ ] `CalloutModern` renders Info / Pro / Warning as border-first cards using `--color-info` / `--color-brand` / `--color-star` accents with a brand-soft surface — no gradient, no `bg-clip-text`.
- [ ] No new design tokens introduced; all new CSS references existing `--color-*` / `--radius*` / `--space-*` / `--font-*` variables.
- [ ] All new rules are scoped under `.theme-modern`; control pages and un-wrapped surfaces are visually unchanged.
- [ ] Existing modern pages (Reviews/Home/Guide/Compare/Research/BlogListing) render identically (visual diff / `npm run build` passes) — this issue only ADDS scoped rules and one component.

## Design references

- Tokens + reusable classes: `src/styles/theme-modern.css` — `.btn` (267-345), `.badge`/`.chip` (350-384), `.card`/`.card-raised` (389-420), `.compare` (776-812), `.stars` (666-691), tokens (29-103), scope root (22).
- Exemplary modern page to mirror: `src/pages/Reviews.modern.jsx` (wrapper at :144, import at :18).
- Reusable components: `src/components/modern/ProductCardModern.jsx`, `src/components/modern/ComparisonTableModern.jsx`.
- Self-hosted fonts (no CDN): `src/styles/fonts-modern.css`.

## Files

- `src/styles/theme-modern.css` — add scoped `input`/`select`/`textarea`/`input[type=range]`/`progress` rules.
- `src/components/modern/CalloutModern.jsx` — NEW callout component (Info/Pro/Warning).
- `src/components/modern/README.md` — NEW reuse map + per-surface migration recipe.
- Read-only references: `src/components/ui/{button,card,badge,input,slider,progress,alert}.jsx`, `src/pages/Reviews.modern.jsx`.

issues.title: Restyle shared header / nav / chrome to the modern design system
issues.body:
## Context

The 6 primary pages shipped the modern design system to 100% of users — warm paper background, Fraunces + Inter, border-first cards, a single reserved conversion orange, deeper brand green, no gradient clip-text. The **shared header/nav/chrome in `Layout.jsx`** was NOT restyled and still uses the old language: a green→blue page-wrapper gradient, a stark-white glass bar with a green hairline, a gradient clip-text logo wordmark, a saturated-green spinning logo mark, neon-green nav/active states, and a heavy `shadow-2xl` / 12px-radius mega-menu.

Because the header sits ABOVE each page's `theme-modern` wrapper, it is the ONE piece of chrome every visitor sees on every modern page — so the clash is maximally visible. **The header CTA is already correctly modern-gated** (deep green, no orange — see the `isModern` branch at Layout.jsx:86-90), which proves the pattern; this issue finishes the job for the rest of the chrome. `StickyMobileCTA` needs minor token fixes too (its buy CTA is already correctly orange).

**Priority p0**: highest visibility of any surface — appears on 100% of pages for 100% of users, including every modern page where the mismatch is jarring.

## Scope

**Header bar (`Layout.jsx`)**
- [ ] Replace page-wrapper `bg-gradient-to-br from-green-50 via-white to-blue-50` (line 109) with warm paper (`--color-paper`).
- [ ] Swap header `border-b border-green-100` (line 118) for a warm hairline (`--color-border`); tint the `bg-white/80` bar toward paper, keep `backdrop-blur-md`.
- [ ] Logo wordmark (line 141): remove `bg-clip-text text-transparent`; render SOLID `--color-brand` (#15803d) in Fraunces (`--font-display`).
- [ ] Logo mark tile (lines 134-140): drop the `from-green-500 to-green-600` gradient for solid brand green (or brand-soft tile + brand leaf) at 8px `--radius`; remove the 360° hover spin (or reduce to a subtle transform). Apply the same to the footer mark (line 490).

**Nav + active states (`Layout.jsx`)**
- [ ] Desktop/mobile nav links (lines 167-218, 348-365): idle `--color-ink-soft`, hover `--color-brand`; active underline/pill uses deeper `--color-brand` / `--color-brand-soft` (not `green-600`/`green-100`), with a 180ms ease-out instead of the framer spring.

**Mega-menu dropdown (`Layout.jsx` portal, lines 401-474)**
- [ ] Border-first: 1px `--color-border` + `--elev-1` warm shadow (drop `shadow-2xl`); 8px `--radius` (replace `rounded-xl`); surface `--color-surface`.
- [ ] Cluster links `--color-brand-strong`, spoke links `--color-ink-soft` → hover `--color-brand`; replace `border-gray-100` dividers with `--color-border`.

**Mobile menu chrome (`Layout.jsx`, lines 264-362)**
- [ ] Replace all `green-100/50/200` container/border/active tints with `--color-border` (neutral) + `--color-brand-soft` (active section) + `--color-brand-strong` (active text); keep green only as link-accent text.

**StickyMobileCTA (`StickyMobileCTA.jsx`)**
- [ ] Rank badge (line 83): recolor `bg-orange-500` → brand (`--color-brand-soft` bg / `--color-brand` text) — orange is reserved for the buy CTA only.
- [ ] Bar (line 76): warm surface + `--color-border` top border instead of `border-gray-200`; drop `shadow-lg` for a subtle warm shadow.
- [ ] Star (line 91): use warm-gold `--color-star` (#E8A317) instead of `fill-yellow-400`.
- [ ] LEAVE the Check Price button orange (line 105) — that is correct per spec.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No gradient clip-text anywhere in the header/footer wordmark (`grep -n bg-clip-text src/components/layout/Layout.jsx` returns nothing).
- [ ] Page-wrapper background is a single warm-paper tone; no `from-green-50 via-white to-blue-50` gradient remains.
- [ ] Header hairline, mega-menu border, mobile-menu borders, and sticky-CTA top border all use the warm `--color-border` token — no `border-green-*`/`border-gray-*` chrome borders remain.
- [ ] Nav idle/hover/active colors resolve to `--color-ink-soft` / `--color-brand`; active green is the deeper #15803d, not neon `green-600`.
- [ ] Mega-menu uses 8px radius + `--elev-1` (no `shadow-2xl`, no `rounded-xl`).
- [ ] Logo mark + wordmark render in the Fraunces/brand-green treatment; 360° spin removed or reduced.
- [ ] Orange appears in the chrome ONLY on the StickyMobileCTA "Check Price" buy button — the rank badge is no longer orange; the star uses `--color-star`.
- [ ] a11y preserved: mobile hamburger keeps its 44px touch target and aria-* attributes; `:focus-visible` outline uses the modern `--color-info` ring; the mega-menu portal / Escape / outside-click behavior is unchanged.
- [ ] The already-modern header CTA gating (`isModern` branch, lines 86-90) is preserved; the CTA is NOT turned orange.
- [ ] Verified on desktop (about, blog-post) and mobile (about, calculator) — chrome reads as continuous warm-paper modern on all four; `npm run build` passes.

## Design references

- Tokens: `src/styles/theme-modern.css` — `--color-paper`, `--color-surface`, `--color-border`, `--color-brand`, `--color-brand-strong`, `--color-brand-soft`, `--color-star`, `--font-display`, `--radius`, `--elev-1`, `--transition`.
- Page to mirror: `src/pages/Reviews.modern.jsx` (H1 solid-ink + `.accent`, border-first surfaces, brand-green active state, orange reserved for CTAs).
- Component reference: `src/components/modern/ProductCardModern.jsx` (border-first card + single orange CTA).
- Precedent already in-file: the header CTA `isModern` branch at `Layout.jsx:86-90`.

## Files

- `src/components/layout/Layout.jsx` (header bar, logo, nav, active states, mega-menu portal, mobile menu, footer mark).
- `src/components/StickyMobileCTA.jsx` (rank badge, bar surface/border, star).
- `src/styles/theme-modern.css` (reference only — chrome is global, so apply tokens inline or extend the wrapper; confirm no regression to control pages).

issues.title: Restyle the global footer to the modern design system
issues.body:
## Context

The 6 primary pages shipped the modern design system to 100% of users (warm paper `--color-paper` #FAF8F4, Fraunces headings, Inter body, border-first cards, orange only for affiliate CTAs, green as a flat brand accent, no gradient clip-text, 8px radius).

The **shared global footer** in `src/components/layout/Layout.jsx` (lines 485-588) was NOT restyled. It renders under EVERY page — including all the now-modern pages — so its inconsistency is maximally visible: the warm-paper modern body abruptly meets a cold near-black `bg-gray-900` slab at the bottom of every frame. The footer still uses a gradient-green logo chip (`from-green-500 to-green-600`), sans-serif `font-semibold` column headings, and raw `text-gray-300/400` grays tuned for a dark ground. Notably, `useModernExperiment()` is already destructured in this same file (line 86-87, `isModern`) and used to re-tone the header CTA — the footer just never got the same treatment.

## Scope

- [ ] **Adopt the modern theme scope.** Wrap the footer in `.theme-modern` (or gate a modern footer branch on the existing `isModern` from line 87) so it inherits paper bg, Fraunces, border-first surfaces, tokens, and 4/8 rhythm.
- [ ] **Background + separation.** Replace `bg-gray-900 text-white` (line 485) with a light warm surface — `--color-paper` or `--color-surface` — separated from the page body by a single 1px `--color-border` top hairline (border-first, no heavy shadow).
- [ ] **Logo mark.** Replace the `bg-gradient-to-br from-green-500 to-green-600` chip (line 490) with a solid `--color-brand` (#15803d) fill at 8px `--radius` — no gradient (mirror the header CTA de-gradient).
- [ ] **Headings → Fraunces.** Render the 'DHM Guide' wordmark (line 493) and the 'Quick Links' / 'Resources' column headings (lines 507, 530) in `--font-display` (Fraunces), solid `--color-ink`, never gradient clip-text.
- [ ] **Text + links → tokens.** Swap `text-gray-300/400` and hover `text-white` (lines 495, 498, 501, 508, 520, 531) for `--color-ink` (headings), `--color-ink-soft` #4A4E48 (disclosure/secondary copy incl. the Amazon Associates line and copyright), and `--color-info`/`--color-brand` links with the modern link hover.
- [ ] **Spacing/radius rhythm.** Keep the 4-column grid but align paddings/gaps to the 4/8 `--space-*` tokens; use `--radius` on the logo chip.
- [ ] **Keep orange out.** No footer links are affiliate/buy CTAs, so `--color-cta` must not appear anywhere in the footer.
- [ ] **Preserve behavior.** No changes to `handleNavigation`, `navItems`/`footerItems` mapping, Ctrl/Cmd-click handling, or the Amazon Associates disclosure copy.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Footer background is a light warm surface (paper/surface token), not `bg-gray-900`, and reads as a continuation of the modern pages.
- [ ] Footer is scoped under `.theme-modern` (or a modern branch gated on `isModern`) so all tokens cascade in.
- [ ] Logo chip is a solid `--color-brand` fill at 8px radius — zero gradients in the footer.
- [ ] 'DHM Guide' wordmark and both column headings render in Fraunces display, solid ink, no clip-text.
- [ ] Body copy, disclosure, and copyright use `--color-ink-soft`; links use info/brand tokens with the modern hover.
- [ ] Text contrast on the new light surface meets WCAG AA (≥4.5:1 body, ≥3:1 large headings) — verify the small disclosure/copyright text especially.
- [ ] No orange (`--color-cta`) anywhere in the footer.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes and the footer looks consistent under a modern page (Reviews) on desktop AND mobile.

## Design references

- Tokens: `src/styles/theme-modern.css` — palette (29-44), Fraunces `--font-display` (50), heading rules (129-154), link rules (161-171), border-first cards (§7, 389-395), 4/8 spacing (76-85), 8px `--radius` (72).
- Page to mirror: `src/pages/Reviews.modern.jsx` — `.theme-modern` wrapper (144) and the header-CTA de-gradient precedent in `Layout.jsx` lines 86-90.

## Files

- `src/components/layout/Layout.jsx` — the `<footer>` block, lines 485-588 (reuse the existing `isModern`/`useModernExperiment` at line 86-87).
- `src/styles/theme-modern.css` — reference only (tokens already exist).

issues.title: Restyle the blog post template (NewBlogPost.jsx, ~197 posts) to the modern design system
issues.body:
## Context The 6 primary pages and the blog *listing* page shipped on the modern design system. The **blog POST template** — `src/newblog/components/NewBlogPost.jsx`, which renders **all ~197 posts and is our single biggest organic-traffic surface** — was NOT restyled. It still uses the old look: a green→blue page gradient, bold system-sans gray headings, heavy `rounded-xl shadow-lg` cards, green/amber/orange comparison tables, a rainbow of colored callout boxes, and green-gradient emphasis text (`gradient-text-green`). Every reader arriving from Google search lands here first, so the clash is the most-seen inconsistency on the site. This is the highest-leverage restyle (p0-adjacent; tagged p1 given XL scope — **split into stacked sub-PRs**). **Mass-edit moratorium (CLAUDE.md, active until 2026-07-15):** this issue touches TEMPLATE/COMPONENT files, NOT the `src/newblog/data/posts/*.json` bodies, so it does not trip the >20-post-JSON guardrail. Do not batch post-content edits into these PRs. ## Scope Wrap the template subtree in `.theme-modern`, `import '../styles/theme-modern.css'`, and call `preloadModernFonts()` on mount (mirror Reviews.modern.jsx:16,55-57,144). Then, roughly in reading order: **Foundation** - [ ] Replace `bg-gradient-to-br from-green-50 to-blue-50` on the wrapper + loading + error states (lines 720, 669, 687) with `--color-paper`. - [ ] Replace the green-gradient reading-progress bar fill (line 728) with `--color-brand`. **Article header / hero** - [ ] H1/subtitle (lines 798-805): Fraunces display, solid `--color-ink`, fluid `--text-h1`/`--text-h2`. Make the subtitle a styled `.lead` `

` (not an `

`) so the outline is clean h1→h2→h3. - [ ] Breadcrumb / back-link / Share (lines 741, 760, 785): `--color-brand`/`--color-brand-strong`, not raw green-600. - [ ] Tag pills (line 822): convert `bg-green-100 ... rounded-full` to `.chip` (1px `--color-border` + brand-soft). **Body prose (the biggest lever)** - [ ] Narrow the content column from `max-w-3xl` (line 954) toward `--container-prose` (45rem / ~720px); paragraphs cap at ~70ch. - [ ] Paragraphs (line 1163): Inter body at `--text-body` (17px), `--leading-body` 1.6, `--color-ink`/`--color-ink-soft`. Reconcile `prose prose-green` (line 955) with the modern body scale. - [ ] In-body H2/H3 (lines 968-995): Fraunces, solid ink; remove the decorative green gradient rule line behind H3 (line 993). - [ ] `strong` emphasis (lines 1317-1351): remove green pill backgrounds, the `gradient-text-green` clip-text (line 1344), and the green-chip percentage/stat wrappers (lines 1326, 1337) — use quiet `font-weight:600; color:var(--color-ink)`. - [ ] Links in prose (lines 1277, 1297, 1307): brand-strong or `--color-info` for science links. - [ ] Lists (lines 1165-1206): drop green gradient bullet dots / numbered green circles (lines 1196, 1202) for the modern list rhythm (recolor to `--color-brand` if kept). - [ ] Blockquote (line 1207): brand-soft surface + `--color-border`, not green-50/green-500. **Callouts / takeaways** - [ ] KeyTakeaways.jsx (line 13): replace `bg-gradient-to-br from-green-50 to-blue-50 ... shadow-lg` with a bordered `.card` on brand-soft, Fraunces title. - [ ] Alert callouts (lines 108-150, 1013-1126) and Quick Answer (line 942): consolidate the blue/amber/green/purple/red boxes onto `CalloutModern` (from the foundation issue) — brand-soft for tips/trust, `--color-info` for science, 1px border + `--radius`; drop gradients. **Inline product / comparison embeds & CTAs** - [ ] `InlineComparisonTable.jsx` (lines 60-61, 85, 104-124, 143, 201): restyle to the modern `.compare` table — brand-soft uppercase header, paper zebra, GREEN winner marker (`inset 3px 0 0 var(--color-brand)`), buy CTA as `.btn .btn-cta`. issues.title: Restyle the DHM Dosage Calculator to the modern design system
issues.body:
## Context

The 6 primary pages shipped to 100% of users on the modern design system: warm paper background, Fraunces + Inter self-hosted type, border-first cards, orange reserved strictly for conversion CTAs, green as the brand accent, solid non-gradient headings, 8px radius, 4/8 spacing.

The **DHM Dosage Calculator** (`/dhm-dosage-calculator`, `src/pages/DosageCalculatorEnhanced.jsx`) was NOT restyled and is the loudest legacy surface on the site: a cool blue→white→green page gradient, five different per-input accent hues (blue/purple/green/orange/indigo), gradient clip-text headings, glassmorphism cards with `shadow-2xl`, blue-gradient primary CTAs, and heavy framer-motion (infinite slider pulses, 360° icon spins, a 20s animated gradient background). Orange leaks onto decorative chrome (a stat number, the tolerance icon tile) while the actual calculate button is blue — the exact inverse of the modern rule.

This is a high-intent tool page feeding affiliate conversion, but it is not the ~197-post blog template — hence **p1, not p0**. It's a **~2,045-line** file with many sub-components (QuickQuiz, ExitIntentPopup, FloatingActions, SocialProofTicker, results/FAQ/CTA sections), so scope the restyle to a **visual token pass, not a rewrite**: wrap + retheme, don't re-architect the calculator logic.

## Scope

- [ ] **Wrap the page body in `<div className="theme-modern">`** and `import '../styles/theme-modern.css'` (mirror Reviews.modern.jsx:18,144). This themes the existing shadcn `Slider`/`Progress`/`Input` for free once the foundation issue's scoped form rules land.
- [ ] **Paper background**: replace root `min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-50 via-white to-green-50` (L799) with `--color-paper`; drop per-section gradients (quiz L924, calculator card L962 + animated overlay L966-978, results L1373, FAQ `bg-gray-50` L1857). Use `.surface-brand` only for deliberate tinted breaks.
- [ ] **Solid Fraunces headings**: remove `bg-clip-text text-transparent` from the hero H1 (L854) and results title (L996); let theme h1/h2/h3 apply Fraunces + `--color-ink`. Optional single green accent word via `.accent`.
- [ ] **Orange-only CTAs**: recolor 'Start Free Calculator' (L907) and 'Calculate My Personalized Dosage' (L1344) to `.btn .btn-cta`. Remove orange from the '15k+' stat (L889) and the Alcohol Tolerance icon tile (L1238). Secondary/utility buttons → `.btn-secondary`.
- [ ] **Kill the per-input rainbow**: unify the five input-card accents (blue L1016/1035/1056, purple L1101/1117, green L1179, orange L1238, indigo L1291) onto one system — icon tiles → `.pathway__icon` (brand-soft), slider value chips → `.chip`, input focus → `--color-info` ring on `--color-border`.
- [ ] **Border-first cards**: replace glassmorphism (`bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-sm border-white/20`, L1010/L1095) and `shadow-2xl` with `.card`/`.card-raised` on `--color-surface`, 1px `--color-border`, 8px radius.
- [ ] **Calm the motion**: remove the infinite slider-chip pulse (L1053-1057), the 360° icon-hover spins (L1014, L1099), the 20s animated gradient background (L966-978), and `animate-pulse` (L993). Keep restrained transitions; gate any reveal behind `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- [ ] **Tokenize shape/spacing/type**: swap `rounded-full`/`rounded-2xl`/`rounded-xl` for `--radius` (pill only for chips/badges), inputs onto `--radius` + `--color-border` + `--color-info` focus (drop `focus:ring-4`), card titles → `.card-title` (Fraunces), section rhythm → `.section` (`--section-y`).
- [ ] **FAQ**: convert the gray numbered-card list (L1857-1913) to the modern `.faq` accordion pattern.
- [ ] **Mobile/a11y fixes**: the full-width `text-xl` CTA (L1344) clips off-screen at 375px — re-size to `.btn .btn-cta .btn-block` (body text, wraps/scales); enforce ≥44px targets on the drinks input (L1117), slider min/max pills, quiz options; the `fixed bottom-6 right-6 w-14 h-14` FAB (L376) overlaps content — remove it or add safe-area + last-card clearance; fix low-contrast `text-xs text-gray-500` disclaimers (L268, L1360) and `text-purple-600` on pink (L844) to token colors passing WCAG AA.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Entire page renders inside `.theme-modern`; `theme-modern.css` imported in the page.
- [ ] Page + section backgrounds are warm `--color-paper`/`--color-surface`; no blue/green/purple/pink page gradients and no animated gradient background remain.
- [ ] All headings are solid `--color-ink` in Fraunces — zero `bg-clip-text text-transparent` in the file.
- [ ] Orange (`--color-cta`) appears ONLY on the primary conversion button(s) via `.btn-cta`; no orange on stats or icon tiles.
- [ ] The five input cards share one accent system (green brand + neutral borders); no per-card blue/purple/green/orange/indigo theming.
- [ ] Cards are border-first (`.card`/`.card-raised`); no glassmorphism or `shadow-2xl`; radii are 8px (pills only for chips/badges).
- [ ] No infinite/looping animations, no 360° icon spins; motion respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- [ ] No horizontal scroll at 320/375/414px; the primary CTA label is fully visible/un-clipped; all interactive controls keep ≥44px touch targets; the FAB no longer overlaps content; focus states use `:focus-visible`.
- [ ] Small/secondary text passes WCAG AA on the final paper backgrounds; FAQ uses the modern `.faq` accordion pattern.
- [ ] Calculator logic, state, tracking (`trackEvent`, affiliate links, `data-*`), and `useSEO` are unchanged — visual pass only.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes and the page visually matches the modern system against Reviews.modern.jsx.

## Design references

- Tokens + classes: `src/styles/theme-modern.css` — paper/surface (29-36), `.btn`/`.btn-cta` (265-345), `.card`/`.card-raised` (389-412), `.chip`/`.badge` (350-384), `.pathway__icon` (951-962), `.faq` (826-866), `.section` (220-222), `.accent` (250-251).
- Page to mirror: `src/pages/Reviews.modern.jsx` (import L18, wrapper L144).
- Card/CTA/stars reference: `src/components/modern/ProductCardModern.jsx`.
- Scoped form rules + focus: from the foundation issue (`src/components/modern/README.md`).

## Files

- `src/pages/DosageCalculatorEnhanced.jsx` (primary — wrap + retheme; ~2,045 lines; includes QuickQuiz / ExitIntentPopup / FloatingActions / SocialProofTicker / results / FAQ / CTA).
- `src/styles/theme-modern.css` (reference only — no new tokens; reuse existing scoped classes).
- No routing/logic changes expected.

## Context

The 6 primary pages were restyled to the modern 2026 design language (`.theme-modern` — warm paper background, Fraunces headings, Inter body, border-first cards, orange reserved only for affiliate/buy CTAs, green demoted to a brand/trust accent). This is a low-traffic but 100%-of-broken-links surface — anyone hitting a dead URL lands here, so it should still match. It's a self-contained single component, so the change is small (S).

Both actions here are internal navigation, NOT affiliate buys, so render them as neutral modern buttons — primary `.btn` (or `.btn-secondary`), secondary 'See Top DHM Products' → `.btn .btn-secondary`.
